title: Woman Thinks She Can Outsmart Police, Serious Charges Follow
description:
#news #police #arrest

On May 15th, 2023. An officer conducted a traffic stop on a woman who had a BOLO (Be On The Lookout) for credit card fraud. When the officer asked her to step out of the vehicle, she started acting very weird and suspicious. She was caught with multiple credit cards, ledgers and had a bag of meth on her. 

Watch the full video to find out what happened next.
